# PySpark DataFrame, grouping, and windows

This page maps 152 PySpark names onto their Batcher spellings, grouped by the class or module they live on. Each row reads in both directions. {doc}`index` explains the statuses and the waves.

To rewrite PySpark code onto these spellings, run the codemod:

```bash
python -m batcher.migrate --from pyspark --to batcher <paths>
```

Replace `<paths>` with the files or directories to rewrite. This direction is implemented. Without `--write` the command prints a diff and changes nothing, and `--write` applies it.

|---|---|---|---|
| `agg` | {py:obj}`GroupBy.agg <batcher.GroupBy.agg>` | canonical |  |
| `apply` | {py:obj}`GroupBy.map_groups <batcher.GroupBy.map_groups>` | mismatch | Differs: deprecated grouped-map pandas UDF: fn(pandas.DataFrame) with a declared schema; map\_groups passes a pyarrow.RecordBatch and infers the schema. Wave W11. |
